name: harness-tuner
description: Meta-plugin: optimize the Claude Code harness for a project. Reads session transcripts to digest recurring user friction, audits CLAUDE.md / skills / rules / commands / hooks / monitors across the hierarchy, and recommends additions / edits / removals -- never touching the root CLAUDE.md. Hierarchy-aware (parent-but-not-root); uses @ imports for cwd-relative content; for monorepos, can author a per-service summary CLAUDE.md that autoloads when working in that subtree. Active development: M1 ships /digest (transcript-only). M2 adds /audit, M3 adds /plan, M4 adds /tune (apply with confirmation).
